who: Richard J. Jensen, historian of American political and social history at the University of Illinois Chicago.

evidence.says: UIC lists Richard Jensen as dissertation adviser to John Morello and Donald H. Parkerson, with the dissertation titles supplied in this group.
Identifies Richard Joseph Jensen as a University of Illinois Chicago history professor and author of The Winning of the Midwest.
The proposed authority is Jensen, Richard Bach, author of Liberty and Order and The Battle against Anarchist Terrorism.
Publisher biography identifies Richard Bach Jensen as history professor at Northwestern State University, specializing in the repression of anarchist terrorism.

notes: The candidate authority belongs to Richard Bach Jensen, a different historian from the UIC supervisor Richard Joseph Jensen.

who: Anthony J. Barbieri, publishing as Anthony J. Barbieri-Low, historian of early China at UC Santa Barbara; PhD Princeton 2001.

notes: ORCID-linked work identifies the UCSB scholar; the listed Kim dissertation and Princeton degree independently agree.
